Không mặt người thật: K1/K3/K5 chỉ nhân vật đại diện tự nghĩ ra (có mặt được, HIEN-CHUONG §4); K2/K4 không người. V3: neo cuối không người tiền cảnh mới (không thêm người). V7 ≤ 2 lượt/khe, lượt 2 đổi lời. MR-6: K1 l1 failed (bị lọc) → lượt 2 + personGeneration allow_adult; K3/K5 thêm allow_adult trước khi chạy.

luot1.prompt: Animate this painted illustration with subtle motion, keeping the exact hand-painted digital painting style, brushwork, film grain and teal-and-amber palette; it must stay a painting, not photorealistic. Static camera with a very slow gentle push in. Pale dawn light slowly brightens through the window; steam rises softly from the coffee mug; the woman looks down at the phone in her hands and a soft glow from the phone lights her face, she smiles faintly. She stays seated, same face, same clothes. Nobody else enters. No text appears anywhere.
luot1.negative: photorealistic, live action, text, letters, numbers, logos, subtitles, screen content, extra people, face morphing, changing identity, hands deforming, camera shake, fast motion
